entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure the Assembly vote must co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure the Assembly vote must count for something... I mean, it passed by ninety percent, for God's sake!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian, Petr and I convened on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian, Petr and I convened on the massive balcony of the palace. It was nice to catch a breeze in the increasing summer heat.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We barely squeaked by with the Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "We barely squeaked by with the Assembly. It was a tough win..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We may need to take some extreme m..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may need to take some extreme measures, though."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""If we cannot get Mrs. Edmond's cen..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we cannot get Mrs. Edmond's centrists, we will have no choice but to reach out to the Old Guard."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked at both of us with a..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked at both of us with a raised eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, she could probably pass as o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, she could probably pass as one..."
entries.menuText: "Well, she could probably pass as one..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both had grins on their faces, but..."
entries.dialogueText: Both had grins on their faces, but Petr's got larger as he kept recounting our success in the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hey, we won the vote comfortably...."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, we won the vote comfortably. I'm sure that counts for something."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""He refused to speak with us.""
entries.dialogueText: "He refused to speak with us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""They wouldn't dare reject such a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "They wouldn't dare reject such a popular proposal."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""By convincing all of the other Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "By convincing all of the other Justices. Every single one."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""There is at least some pressure on..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is at least some pressure on the Court now."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...Now we have the council of grum..."
entries.dialogueText: "...Now we have the council of grumpy old men in our way."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Old Guard won't have any troub..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Old Guard won't have any trouble justifying a rejection."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Fellas! The first obstacle has bee..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fellas! The first obstacle has been cleared! Congratulations to all of us."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We've come this far. Anything is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've come this far. Anything is possible."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It was indeed a historic vote. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was indeed a historic vote. The President has accomplished something even Tarquin Soll had trouble with."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have to say, that's a fitting de..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to say, that's a fitting description for the Court. But unfortunately for us, they are more than that. They're our largest obstacle yet."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But this may also make the Court s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But this may also make the Court see you as the ultimate threat. I wouldn't be so relaxed."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Indeed. But then again, so was sec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. But then again, so was securing the Assembly vote."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The Court still sees us as a threa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Court still sees us as a threat. They will not be persuaded so easily."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's going to be tough.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's going to be tough."
entries.menuText: "It's going to be tough."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If the Old Guard is against us......"
entries.dialogueText: "If the Old Guard is against us... How do we even get six votes?"
entries.menuText: "If the Old Guard is against us... How do we even get six votes?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If the Justices fail us at this st..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Justices fail us at this stage, I'm sure the people will see them for who they really are."
entries.menuText: "If the Justices fail us at this stage, I'm sure the people will see them for who they really are."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. I'll talk to the Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I'll talk to the Justices and convince them."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. I'll talk to the Justices and convince them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We never expected this to be easy...."
entries.dialogueText: "We never expected this to be easy. Nothing has changed."
entries.menuText: "We never expected this to be easy. Nothing has changed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think we can do it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think we can do it?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think we can do it?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""She's a tough woman. I doubt that..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's a tough woman. I doubt that she'll be persuaded at this point."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Also... You are forgetting about M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also... You are forgetting about Mrs. Edmonds. They're not all grumpy old men."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And Nia was pretty adamant about h..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Nia was pretty adamant about her position against the proposal. That's already one vote lost out of eleven."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mrs. Morgna has been helping out w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Morgna has been helping out with the lobbying of the Court. She has been speaking with Mrs. Edmonds, and we believe she's our key figure on the inside."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah...""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I wouldn't be so sure, sir. They c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be so sure, sir. They control more than the Court, as you know."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... That gives us three votes to..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... That gives us three votes to start with."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And the average citizen has no int..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the average citizen has no interest in such matters. The public won't be very helpful."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We've come this far. Anything is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've come this far. Anything is possible."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's true, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's true, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr started laughing."
entries.dialogueText: Petr started laughing.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I believe in you, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I believe in you, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""In any case, we should start with..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, we should start with our best bet. I already asked Nia to arrange a meeting with Mrs. Edmonds."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We surely cannot. We'll need to wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We surely cannot. We'll need to work with Mr. Garaci and Mrs. Edmonds to undermine Orso."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's a tough spot to be in. As I s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a tough spot to be in. As I said, we have no other way but to convince Mr. Hawker's fellow Old Guard members behind his back."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Also, even if she was with us, tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also, even if she was with us, that wouldn't change the current climate."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""She's willing to speak with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's willing to speak with you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Wait. Did you just call Nia a grum..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Did you just call Nia a grumpy old woman?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How about Heron Garaci?""
entries.dialogueText: "How about Heron Garaci?"
entries.menuText: "How about Heron Garaci?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. I'll make sure she joins us...."
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'll make sure she joins us. Just watch."
entries.menuText: "Good. I'll make sure she joins us. Just watch."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come on, gentlemen, let's not over..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, gentlemen, let's not overthink this."
entries.menuText: "Come on, gentlemen, let's not overthink this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, Nia has the ears of Justices..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, Nia has the ears of Justices Dalton and Martin. So, we could assume that we have their support as well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The real trouble is their big dadd..."
entries.dialogueText: "The real trouble is their big daddy Hawker. We can't let him control the Court against us."
entries.menuText: "The real trouble is their big daddy Hawker. We can't let him control the Court against us."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm not trying to be pessimistic,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not trying to be pessimistic, but Mrs. Morgna cannot do this alone. Let's not forget about Mr. Hawker. And his loyalists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""...And Mrs. Morgna. She's technica..."
entries.dialogueText: "...And Mrs. Morgna. She's technically a member too."
entries.menuText: "...And Mrs. Morgna. She's technically a member too."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He refused to speak with you, Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: "He refused to speak with you, Petr. But if the president can have a one-on-one meeting with him, I'm sure he'll open up."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""With all due respect, sir, this is..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, sir, this is the most crucial step in passing your reforms. It cannot be overthought."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure you'll convince her.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you'll convince her."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Indeed. But then again, so was win..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. But then again, so was winning over the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm afraid she is. I knew she woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid she is. I knew she would be a headache..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mrs. Morgna has been reluctant to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Morgna has been reluctant to help with the lobbying of the Court. But she has accepted to at least try and convince the Justices to organize a meeting with us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""She has the ears of Justices Dalto..."
entries.dialogueText: "She has the ears of Justices Dalton and Martin. So, we could assume that we have their support as well."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Which means our lobbying efforts h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which means our lobbying efforts have not yet borne fruit. It will be up to you and Mrs. Morgna, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine. We can do it together...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. We can do it together. I trust Nia."
entries.menuText: "It's fine. We can do it together. I trust Nia."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll still need to reach out to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll still need to reach out to the Old Guard and the moderates in order to reach six votes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Let's not over-assume, Petr. Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not over-assume, Petr. Mrs. Morgna has already made her position known. She will not support the proposal."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not to make it sound more depressi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to make it sound more depressing, but it's not only about her. Let's not forget about Mr. Hawker. And his loyalists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So, she's serious about voting aga..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, she's serious about voting against the proposal?"
entries.menuText: "So, she's serious about voting against the proposal?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't let her sabotage our effor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't let her sabotage our efforts. She's a minister of my cabinet, she *will* give me her vote."
entries.menuText: "I can't let her sabotage our efforts. She's a minister of my cabinet, she *will* give me her vote."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ouch.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ouch."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's going to be tough.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's going to be tough."
entries.menuText: "It's going to be tough."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine. We can do it without he..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. We can do it without her."
entries.menuText: "It's fine. We can do it without her."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Anyway...""
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What? I mean... She would probably..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? I mean... She would probably support us after that win, no?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed. Lucian look at him with..."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed. Lucian look at him with a raised eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't know about that, Anton. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know about that, Anton. You have to convince her yourself, if you can."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: He cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If the reformist justices are agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the reformist justices are against us along with the Old Guard... How do we even get six votes?"
entries.menuText: "If the reformist justices are against us along with the Old Guard... How do we even get six votes?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think we can do it?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think we can do it?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think we can do it?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's four or five votes gone, ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's four or five votes gone, right from the start."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hasn't she managed to lobby anyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hasn't she managed to lobby anyone else?"
entries.menuText: "Hasn't she managed to lobby anyone else?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""About the Court...""
entries.dialogueText: "About the Court..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Our lobbying efforts are continuin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our lobbying efforts are continuing positively, but they have yet to yield concrete results. It will be ultimately up to Mrs. Morgna and you to persuade the Justices, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. We'll need to reach out to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. We'll need to reach out to the Old Guard and the moderates in order to reach six votes. There is not much leeway."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And we already have Nia inside the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we already have Nia inside the Court. That's one vote out of eleven."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Which leaves us five more...""
entries.dialogueText: "Which leaves us five more..."
entries.menuText: "Which leaves us five more..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can we even trust her to bring the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we even trust her to bring the other Justices to the table?"
entries.menuText: "Can we even trust her to bring the other Justices to the table?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't know, but she promised to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know, but she promised to talk Mrs. Edmonds into having a meeting with you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In the end, we cannot trust anyone..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the end, we cannot trust anyone, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you again for your hard work..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you again for your hard work, Petr."
entries.menuText: "Thank you again for your hard work, Petr."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can celebrate once we get past..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can celebrate once we get past the Court."
entries.menuText: "We can celebrate once we get past the Court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Great job, gentlemen!""
entries.dialogueText: "Great job, gentlemen!"
entries.menuText: "Great job, gentlemen!"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It was nothing, Anton. It was most..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was nothing, Anton. It was mostly you."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What about Tarquin Soll? Did you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about Tarquin Soll? Did you see him again?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The president's right. The Assembl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The president's right. The Assembly was the easy part."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr leaned on the balcony railing."
entries.dialogueText: Petr leaned on the balcony railing.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As far as I know he's still stayin..."
entries.dialogueText: "As far as I know he's still staying in Holsord, but hasn't cared to pay his respects to President Rayne yet."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But for now, let's move on.""
entries.dialogueText: "But for now, let's move on."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In any case, I will conduct proper..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any case, I will conduct proper investigations into this. We should know every hidden Old Guard member who is working with Soll."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Okay...""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He saw their faces, but didn't rec..."
entries.dialogueText: "He saw their faces, but didn't recognize them."
entries.menuText: "He saw their faces, but didn't recognize them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's not name any names now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not name any names now."
entries.menuText: "Let's not name any names now."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What the hell was that all about a..."
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell was that all about anyway? Him appearing out of nowhere..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's just move on with our next s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just move on with our next steps."
entries.menuText: "Let's just move on with our next steps."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe you should have. Even Serge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."
entries.menuText: "Maybe you should have. Even Serge knew about it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's done is done. Let's not lin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."
entries.menuText: "What's done is done. Let's not linger in the past."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sorry that we failed to warn y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry that we failed to warn you he would be attending, Mr. President. We should have been informed about his arrival."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, the laws protect him from al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the laws protect him from almost anything, and allow him to be a member of the Assembly. He can still propose bills and vote for them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He came to the Assembly to make a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He came to the Assembly to make a statement. But we still won the vote."
entries.menuText: "He came to the Assembly to make a statement. But we still won the vote."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh, he did? Who were they?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, he did? Who were they?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's too bad.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's too bad."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But he has no authority anymore.""
entries.dialogueText: "But he has no authority anymore."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, he didn't.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, he didn't."
entries.menuText: "No, he didn't."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he did.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he did."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he did."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As long as he's around, he will al..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as he's around, he will always have influence over the republic he built. We should have seen this coming."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""He wished to intimidate the Assemb..."
entries.dialogueText: "He wished to intimidate the Assembly into rejecting our proposal, sir. And it seems to have failed. But we can't be sure. He might be here to work with the Court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you think was his real int..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think was his real intention?"
entries.menuText: "What do you think was his real intention?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course not, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""He didn't see who they were, did h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He didn't see who they were, did he?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Soll might be working behind the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soll might be working behind the scenes against us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""What? Me? Never!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? Me? Never!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It seems some of our respected MPs..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems some of our respected MPs already knew about this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I guess not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess not."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""With him around, we have to be ext..."
entries.dialogueText: "With him around, we have to be extra careful."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We cannot let the party slip from..."
entries.dialogueText: "We cannot let the party slip from our grasp."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It doesn't matter now, does it?""
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter now, does it?"
entries.menuText: "It doesn't matter now, does it?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Still, sir, we should have been mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, sir, we should have been more aware. But it's time to plan ahead now."
